verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents a first-party API Playground for trying live streaming transcription (deepgram-docs-25), which gives runnable, interactive examples. A probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec (deepgram-probe-3) that could back a reference, but no evidence shows the API reference pages themselves are interactive with try-it-now calls. The 2018 report of broken docs links (deepgram-comm-3) is old and does not concretely contradict the current Playground. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API reference with in-page runnable requests across endpoints, coverage beyond live streaming, independent hands-on corroboration.
